description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing TPM resources, including locking mechanisms and object slot management, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: EsysLock
classes.description: A lock wrapper around the ESYS_CONTEXT* to ensure thread-safe access to TPM context.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager
classes.description: Manages TPM object slots and provides thread-safe access to the TPM context.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot
classes.description: Represents a slot for a TPM object, allowing retrieval and assignment of TPM resources.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Returns the underlying ESYS_CONTEXT* for TPM operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the ESYS_TR resource handle associated with the slot.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a TPM resource handle to the slot.

methods.name: Esys
methods.description: Returns an EsysLock object that manages access to the TPM context with locking.

methods.name: ReserveSlot
methods.description: Reserves a TPM object slot for use.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TPM resource manager with a TPM context.

methods.name: ~TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up TPM resource manager.

methods.name: ObjectSlot
methods.description: Constructor for creating an object slot, either empty or with a specific resource.
